description: This file defines an abstract base class for routing strategies in a caching and Redis management context, providing core functionalities like batching Redis increments, periodic synchronization, and managing in-memory cache updates.

classes.name: BaseRoutingStrategy
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common functions for different routing strategies, handling Redis batching, in-memory cache updates, and synchronization tasks.

methods.name: __init__( self, dual_cache: DualCache, should_batch_redis_writes: bool, default_sync_interval: Optional[Union[int, float]], )
methods.description: Constructor initializing caches, synchronization task setup, and in-memory keys set.

methods.name: setup_sync_task(self, default_sync_interval: Optional[Union[int, float]])
methods.description: Configures an asyncio task for periodic synchronization between in-memory cache and Redis.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Performs cleanup by cancelling the periodic sync task during shutdown.

methods.name: List[float] _increment_value_list_in_current_window( self, increment_list: List[Tuple[str, int]], ttl: int )
methods.description: Increments a list of key-value pairs within the current window asynchronously.

methods.name: _increment_value_in_current_window( self, key: str, value: Union[int, float], ttl: int )
methods.description: Increments a single key's spend within an existing budget window, updating in-memory cache and queuing Redis pipeline operation.

methods.name: periodic_sync_in_memory_spend_with_redis( self, default_sync_interval: Optional[Union[int, float]] )
methods.description: Continuously runs the sync process at specified intervals, handling exceptions and errors.

methods.name: _push_in_memory_increments_to_redis(self)
methods.description: Commits batched in-memory increments to Redis, compressing operations for the same key.

methods.name: add_to_in_memory_keys_to_update(self, key: str)
methods.description: Adds a key to the set of keys that need to be synchronized with Redis.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_key_pattern_to_sync(self)
methods.description: Returns the key pattern used to identify keys for synchronization, default implementation returns None.

methods.name: Set[str] get_in_memory_keys_to_update(self)
methods.description: Returns the current set of keys marked for update.

methods.name: Set[str] get_and_reset_in_memory_keys_to_update(self)
methods.description: Atomically retrieves and clears the set of keys to be updated.

methods.name: reset_in_memory_keys_to_update(self)
methods.description: Resets the set of keys to empty.

methods.name: _sync_in_memory_spend_with_redis(self)
methods.description: Ensures in-memory cache reflects Redis values by pushing increments and fetching current Redis values for specified keys.
